tanzania.overview: Over two million wildebeest and plains zebra drive the Great Migration across the Serengeti ecosystem, seen alongside high densities of lions, spotted hyenas, and cheetahs. In the Ngorongoro Crater, elusive black rhinos are occasionally spotted on the open floor, while massive elephant herds congregate around Tarangire National Park's river systems. Forested areas like Arusha National Park support frequently seen black-and-white colobus monkeys.
